text: Critical thinking disposition (CTD) reflects a motivational-cognitive tendency to approach complex problems with openness, reflective scepticism, and sensitivity to evidence. Although emotional intelligence (EI) and teacher professional identity (TPI) may be relevant to CTD, their direct and indirect associations, and whether they represent necessary rather than merely predictive conditions for higher CTD, remain unclear.
source_label: Relationships among emotional intelligence, teacher professional identity, and critical thinking disposition in Chinese pre-service teachers
